prompt:
A desktop e-commerce homepage for SidePlay, a sports and play equipment store in Lebanon, rendered edge to edge as a finished website screen with crisp, readable text; no browser window, device or desk around it.

The visitor's job: find the gear, see its price, and order it in one WhatsApp message to 71 904 725. What leads is giant lowercase type: "gear for every game" set huge across the top and cropped off the right edge, over a strict grid of flat square tiles. Tiles are the doors: seven department tiles (rackets, fitness, basketball, goals & yard, game tables, ride, outdoor) each with item count and starting price, mixed with product tiles showing a real product photo and its price: aluminium scooter $150, adjustable basketball stand $525, Fusiontec tennis racket $50, 65 cm gym ball $26, 2-person pop-up tent $148. One tile holds a search field "what are you playing?" and one large tile says "order on whatsapp 71 904 725". Below, the next pane's giant word "the shop" peeks in.

Frame: the SidePlay logo (SP monogram with speed lines, SIDE in silver, PLAY in red) top left on a small black plate, a few text links, a WhatsApp 71 904 725 link at the right.

The attached references are style inspiration adapted into a real working product; do not copy their layout or content. The client pinned the palette: white ground with flat red tiles and white or red type, black only in small accents, no black background.
